name: Coburg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Coburg (a black Moor's head on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Coburg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Coburg arms — Moor's head on yellow
